files.pandas/tests/groupby/test_receipts_regre:
import pandas as pd


def test_mixed_any_allna_stays_na():
    df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "g": [1, 1, 2, 2],
            "n": [True, False, True, False],
            "e": pd.array([pd.NA, pd.NA, True, False], dtype="boolean"),
        }
    )
    result = df.groupby("g").any()
    v1 = result.loc[1, "e"]
    assert pd.isna(v1)
    v2 = result.loc[2, "e"]
    assert not pd.isna(v2)
    assert v2 == True
    assert isinstance(result["e"].dtype, pd.BooleanDtype)
